headline: Arm Holdings Slips After Hours as Guidance Lacks Blowout Figures
summary: Arm stock declined in after-hours trading as the absence of blowout guidance offset the company's quarterly results.
why: Arm Holdings licenses foundational semiconductor architecture used across the global smartphone and computing industry, making its forward guidance a critical indicator for the tech sector.

impacts.name: Arm Holdings plc
impacts.why: Lack of blowout forward guidance caused shares to slip in after-hours trading.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Investors holding high-valuation semiconductor stocks punished shares after management failed to deliver blowout guidance that exceeded lofty expectations.
